author: gpt-5.6-luna
kind: ticket export (CSV, 140 to 200 tickets) with created dates and labels, a roadmap doc with a scope-lock date and the launch date, a capacity sheet and three short requests from product added after lock
scenario: A director writes: product added work after we locked scope and we are not moving the date. Tell me what we cut to keep it, and what the added work cost us.
seeds: (1) the added work is spread across epics and must be found by created date against the lock date, not by a label (some added tickets lack the label); (2) total added points vs remaining slack gives the exact amount to cut; (3) one cut candidate looks optional but a must-have depends on it; (4) one added ticket is contractual (a customer commitment in the requests doc) and cannot be cut; (5) a decoy: tickets created after lock that are bug splits of pre-lock work with zero net new points (their parent was re-estimated down).
expertSources: The Scrum Guide 2020, https://scrumguides.org/scrum-guide.html (CC BY-SA 4.0, idea only)
GitLab Handbook, Product processes, https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/product-processes/ (CC BY-SA 4.0, idea only)
